commit 2910b197d328961c2c8ffcad7a399dd4908ced57
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Sat Sep 20 05:02:26 2025 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Sat Sep 20 05:02:26 2025 +0000

    Bug 1893950 - Update cmake_define_files.py to properly handle #define lines. r=dandarnell
    
    
    If there was a line like:
      #define FALLTHROUGH_STATEMENT [[fallthrough]]
    that cmake_define_files.py was processing, the output was wrong. These
    lines need to be left as they are.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D265526

diff --git a/python/thirdroc/thirdroc/cmake_define_files.py b/python/thirdroc/thirdroc/cmake_define_files.py
index 188c90ad4d5..a312323af46 100644
--- a/python/thirdroc/thirdroc/cmake_define_files.py
+++ b/python/thirdroc/thirdroc/cmake_define_files.py
@@ -46,21 +46,31 @@ def process_cmake_define_file(output, input_file, extra_defines):
             r'^\s*#\s*(?P<cmd>[a-z]+)(?:\s+(?P<name>\S+)(?:\s+(?P<value>("[^"]+"|\S+)))?)?',
             re.U,
         )
+
+        def replace_define(v):
+            if v.group(1) in defines:
+                return f" {defines[v.group(1)]}"
+            return ""
+
         for line in input_file:
             m = r.match(line)
             if m:
                 cmd = m.group("cmd")
                 name = m.group("name")
                 value = m.group("value")
+                if value is not None:
+                    value = re.sub(r'"?@(.*)@"?', replace_define, value)
                 if name:
                     if cmd == "define":
-                        if value and name in defines:
+                        if name in defines:
                             line = (
                                 line[: m.start("value")]
                                 + str(defines[name])
                                 + line[m.end("value") :]
                             )
-                        elif name not in defines:
+                        elif value and name not in defines:
+                            line = line[: m.start("value")] + value + line[m.end("value") :]
+                        else:
                             line = (
                                 "/* #undef "
                                 + line[m.start("name") : m.end("name")]
title: Bug 1893950 - Update cmake_define_files.py to properly handle #define lines. r=dandarnell
